author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Rapid7 InsightVM findings from the InsightVM Cloud Integrations API (v4). The example bridge in bridges/rapid7-insightvm-findings pulls them and posts one JSON record per finding to HTTP Ingest. Sophos Fusion has no vulnerability schema for custom parsers, so each finding goes to Thirdparty.
notes:
Setup:
- InsightVM has no push for findings, so this parser reads the records the example bridge in bridges/rapid7-insightvm-findings pulls from the InsightVM Cloud Integrations API (v4) on the Insight Platform and posts to HTTP Ingest: one JSON record per finding, with "rapid7_record", the region and the state first, then the asset, the finding and the vulnerability's definition as Rapid7 returns them.
- Give the bridge a user key whose InsightVM user has the User role for the sites it should read.
- Each run sends the findings new on each asset since the last run and those remediated since then; the first run sends each current finding of the assets assessed in the lookback, as same.

Field mapping:
- Sophos Fusion has no vulnerability schema for custom parsers (its Tenable integration fills the Vulnerabilities tab of a detection, which a custom parser can't write), so each finding goes to Thirdparty, the schema the Sophos Fusion schema list gives alerts from sources outside Sophos Fusion.
- Thirdparty gets the definition's title as the title (the vulnerability ID when the bridge runs with RAPID7_DEFINITIONS=0), the proof with its HTML tags taken out as the summary, the asset and vulnerability IDs as alert_id, the state (new, remediated or same) as the status, and the finding's status (such as VULNERABLE_EXPL) as confidence.
- Thirdparty also gets the categories, critical, severe, moderate, low and informational as critical, high, medium, low and info, the Real Risk score as risk_score, the asset's address, name and MAC, the port and protocol, and the found and remediation times.
- The vulnerability and asset IDs, OS, CVEs, CVSS scores, severity score, solution, check ID, NIC, exploits and malware kits go to additional_data.
- The CVSS scores are read from the record's text, because STRING() drops a number's fraction.

Time:
- A remediated finding's event time is its remediation date; any other's is when a scan last found it.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the shapes of the asset and vulnerability examples in Rapid7's v4 API reference.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-22 (107 of 107 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs).
- No built-in parser claimed these records.
